name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Account Manager | Cross-Functional Relationships & Executive Reporting
summary: Client Account Manager with 15+ years as the day-to-day contact and strategic advocate for a portfolio of B2B and B2C clients across MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments. Proven track record serving as the connective tissue between clients and internal teams - Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales - tracking commitments, resolving issues before they escalate, and delivering executive-ready reporting on account health and performance. Comfortable managing multiple concurrent client relationships with high accountability and follow-through.
